verdict.rationale: Attio's pricing page lists "Call Intelligence & sequences" as a plan feature, and its AI page mentions drafting follow-ups. That is a first-party claim of a sequences capability, but it is only a single bare mention with no description of email sending, templates or multi-step behavior. Missing for 10: documentation of email templates, sending email from the CRM, multi-step sequence configuration (steps, delays, enrollment), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
